changeSet.author: str-backend
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE str_rn.registration_number DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_rn_format, DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_rn_status; ALTER TABLE str_rn.registration_number ALTER COLUMN rn TYPE VARCHAR(20); ALTER TABLE str_rn.registration_number ADD CONSTRAINT chk_rn_format CHECK (rn ~ '^HR[0-9A-Fa-f]{18}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_rn_status CHECK (status IN ('IN_PROCESSING', 'ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'WITHDRAWN'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE str_rn.registration_number DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_rn_format, DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_rn_status; ALTER TABLE str_rn.registration_number ALTER COLUMN rn TYPE VARCHAR(18); ALTER TABLE str_rn.registration_number ADD CONSTRAINT chk_rn_format CHECK (rn ~ '^HR[0-9]{8}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_rn_status CHECK (status IN ('IN_PROCESSING', 'ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'WITHDRAWN'))
